description: Financial data and research platform providing comprehensive private market intelligence on companies, investors, deals, and funds.
auth_notes: Authentication details for the direct data API and data feed require enterprise subscription credentials, typically managed through enterprise arrangements.
credential_notes: API and direct data feeds require contacting sales or entering into an enterprise contract; no self-serve free developer signup is available.
api_notes: Covers comprehensive private market data including companies, deals, investors, funds, and financial metrics.
mcp_notes: No official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server published by PitchBook; only enterprise API and data feeds exist.
rationale: PitchBook provides a robust API and data platform, but access is strictly sales-gated for enterprise customers rather than being self-serve.

evidence.note: Describes PitchBook Direct Data, API, and Data Feed options for connecting private market datasets to internal systems.

open_questions: Are there any developer sandbox tiers available post-sales contact?
